investigations.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator

o2.ev: “NASA - considered atmosphere for human space missions will be examined: 14.7 psia, 21 % oxygen: 10.2 psia, 26.5 %; and 8.2 psia, 34 % oxygen.”

lowp.ev: Same statement: tests at 10.2 psia and 8.2 psia.

materials.ev: Fuel is a gas burner that emulates a burning solid, not a spacecraft material.

safety.ev: Keywords: “Fire Safety; Radiative Extinction; Extinction Limit; Flammability”.
